Teenager Arrested in Connection with Nine-Year-Old Boy's Death in Tamil Nadu

A nine-year-old boy was found dead near his home in the Karukkakurichi area of Pudukkottai district, and a 17-year-old student has been arrested in connection with the crime. The police have booked him under various sections. The incident has sent shockwaves through the region.
